notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Update steamworks implementation
 Engine updates
 Gamepad input fixes
 Updated logo sequence
 Add developer cross promo functionality

notes.title: Minor update - fix main menu wishlist button
notes.content:
On the 27th of July we pushed a tiny update to fix the Bore Blasters button on the main menu. Due to engine updates this also had the unintended consequence of disabling gamepad controls. When we were notified of this, we reverted the build.

On the 28th of July we have pushed a build that fixes the button without impacting gamepad controls. If there are any issues, please report in the discussions section.

Thanks to those that reported the issue in the first place, and apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: QoL update
notes.content:
Display number of scrap ups achieved in HUD

Display health when offered the “Restore Shield” upgrade

To avoid confusion, “Restore Shield” is now capped so that x2 or x3 is not offered when it would heal more than the damage taken

Fixed: When selecting weapons with mouse, if the cursor is not moved after clicking reroll once, trying to click a second time will select the card in the center instead of reroll

Attempt to detect when stat descriptions exceed card space to ensure descriptions are readable (primarily impacted German translation)

notes.title: Fixed asteroid bug
notes.content: Fixed bug causing asteroids to spawn every threat level (sorry)

notes.title: PlayStation controller support
notes.content:
Added support for PlayStation controllers

Made asteroids stand out more visually

notes.title: Asteroids!
notes.content:
New in-game event: Asteroid fields can periodically appear!

Added background grid (can be toggled in settings)

Fixed cloud looping on 21:9 resolutions

notes.title: Background Update
notes.content:
Updated backgrounds to reduce motion sickness

Added outline to currently selected upgrade/weapon

Fixed clipping issue in unlock display on game over screen

Changed layout of language confirmation screen

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Achievements and progress are now stored when quitting/restarting runs

Changed logic of icon movement to work consistently in varying frame rates

notes.title: Hotfix 1.28
notes.content: Implemented fix for crash on launch related to applying previously used window size.

notes.title: Olive tweaks
notes.content:
* Fix achievement not unlocking for Olive
* Fix movement glitches for Olive's movement when releasing gamepad joystick

notes.title: HUD upgrade icon tooltips
notes.content:
Added ability to set HUD icon opacity

Added tooltip when mouse hovering over HUD stat icons

notes.title: Nitro
notes.content:
Implemented new character: Nitro

Added extra confirmation to restart game or quit to main menu

notes.title: Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
Values are now displayed in the settings menu.

You can now buy multiple permanent upgrades at once by holding left shift or L-trigger on a gamepad. This is unofficial functionality.

Added support for gamepad 8BitDo SN30+pro on Mac.

This build also includes the weapon controller system overhaul. This should mean the following benefits:

Weapon icons in the bottom left of the game UI should no longer disappear and reappear at random

The icons should always remain in the same order

Weapon cooldowns should be more predictable

notes.title: Weapon System Rewrite
notes.content:
The weapon controller system has been completely overhauled. This should mean the following benefits:

* Weapon icons in the bottom left of the game UI should no longer disappear and reappear at random
* The icons should always remain in the same order
* Weapon cooldowns should be more predictable

Since this is a major update, it will be pushed to the experimental branch before being made live for everyone. If you are playing on the experimental branch, please let me know as soon as possible if you notice any issues.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.20
notes.content:
Show upgrade group icons in bottom left of in-game HUD

Ultimate weapons are now described when offered, replacing the description of the standard weapon

Fixed garbage collection bug that causes slowdown when game is left idling

Nerfed scrap magnet permanent upgrade

notes.title: Hotfix 1.18
notes.content:
Updated Prismatrix prism colouring for improved clarity

Further tweaks to end game (additional new destroyer type)

Restarting game or exiting to main menu now stores credits gained during run

notes.title: End Game Update
notes.content:
Changed end game, introducing new enemy type and restricting to one final boss kill.

Tweaked visual feedback from defeating final boss.

Fix: Applied a failsafe for player damage, with the intent to prevent “ghost hits” (where the player is damaged even when nothing is nearby). PLEASE REPORT IF THIS STILL HAPPENS!

Buffed Prismatrix orbiting prism (increased range, trigger frequency, hitbox size)

Fix: Gamepad Start now pauses the game

Fix: Restrict certain types of input from being mapped

Scaled up damage numbers to better illustrate changes in damage

notes.title: Banish Upgrades
notes.content:
Upgrade banishing feature implemented. Purchase banish credits in Permanent Upgrades. Note that you can mark an upgrade for banishing and still pick it - that way you get it once.

Fixed “double damage” achievement sometimes not unlocking. There was a discrepancy where reaching >=40 threat level triggers the Steam achievement, but >40 threat level was required to unlock the upgrade. The unlock requirement has now been updated to match the Steam achievement, i.e. >=40. This will not apply retrospectively.

notes.title: Weapon rerolls are here!
notes.content:
Weapon rerolls are implemented! Thanks to all the testers. (Note: German and Spanish translations of the new functionality are still in progress.)

Tweaked effect for no shield damage boost

Made Permanent Upgrades menu more readable

Fixed weapon variety damage bonus tooltip getting stuck



We are aware of issue relating to “double damage” skill not unlocking, but the fix has not yet been identified.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.10
notes.content:
Limited the amount of damage numbers that can spawn, in order to safeguard performance.

Fixed error generated by spawning too many damage numbers.

Fixed permanent upgrades not being updated properly.

notes.title: Damage numbers
notes.content: Added damage numbers. Since this may impact performance negatively, they are off by default. To turn damage numbers on, go to Settings.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.8
notes.content: Fixed unlock "Fire 3000 projectiles in a Pyrek run."

notes.title: Hotfix 1.7
notes.content:
Fixed unlock “Stand still for 30 seconds.”

Fixed unlock  “Kill 5 bosses with an explosive weapon.”

Tweaked player ship sprites

Tweaked final boss hit animation

notes.title: Hotfix 1.6
notes.content:
Fix crash on new game

Attempted fix for black screen bug on menu selection. This is likely related to input being registered twice - which means new issues are likely to crop up. We will continue to investigate but this is a tricky issue.

Improved “no shield damage boost” effect (made it subtler)

Game now saves window size and position when not using fullscreen
